criteria.check: Compare all four actual members together at 1x and 3x nearest on #172336 against the exact Ready baseline: coherent deliberate pixel treatment, readable visual weight coherent with the Ready baseline (identical stroke width or footprint is not required), perceptible cool-blue accent and transparent exteriors, including Working's four frames, its actual 100 ms playback with the wrap under normal motion, and the held cell shown stationary under reduced motion; no exact palette, alpha, stroke, margin or copied completion-motif requirement.

View Ready, every Working frame, the running loop AND the stationary held cell, Retry and Paused together at 1x and 3x including a grayscale/non-colour comparison: Working (animated or held) never reads as success; the held cell is distinct from Ready and from Paused by shape or structure alone; Retry and Paused are each distinct from activity (including the held cell), completion and from each other by shape or structure alone; the preserved Start triangle remains separately identifiable from every member including the held cell.

Destination for the successor: src/queue-view-artistic.ts + renderer-artistic/ with the existing asset paths (assets/working.png, assets/ready-confirmed.png, assets/error-retry.png, assets/paused.png, assets/start.svg); src/queue-view.ts, renderer/ and every existing asset byte remain unchanged (hashes compared against the retained baseline). In the successor browser fixture renderer-artistic/view.mjs executing the actual src/queue.ts and src/queue-view-artistic.ts modules, checked by renderer-artistic/check.py against the retained capture, exercise all backend transitions (started, ok, error, pause, plus idle) through both statusCell and compactStatus under normal and reduced preferences with the exact package files at those paths: labels, frame counts (sheet geometry), horizontal slicing, frame index floor(elapsed/100) mod frames at the timeline sample points including the 400 ms wrap under normal and frame 0 at every sample under reduced (wall-clock duration not measured), nearest sampling at scale 1 (state matrix) and 3 (state matrix and live cells), alpha compositing on #172336, and - as the adopted destination-check method - recorded integer canvas placement matching the screenshot pixels; assets/start.svg byte hash unchanged; the fixture executed the successor module and not the retained original.
